about: Interim golden frames: 5 to 10 moments Krish names from Production Inspo (config/style-references.json, Drive folder Ventures > Inspiration > Production Inspo). The Critic ranks plate candidates and judges cuts against them, with Monday 26's frames, until his scores exist. Each slot records a reference and a time only: the clip and any extracted frame stay off the repository (Production Inspo is studied, never published). A slot is filled only with his own words naming it; an agent never fills one for him. Since 12 Nov 2026 a slot can also hold a frame of his own approved, published cut, named by his Approve on the Golden frames card of his Publish Board (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-12: the three video sign-offs are one review card each on his board, with samples, and only his presses write the configs): such a slot records the piece, the cut file's sha256, the time and his press (`source: cut`, velib/signoffs.py), and the still stays in his Drive by its id. His Not this on a candidate is kept under `declined`.
fill: python scripts/ve.py golden fill <slot> --reference <file in config/style-references.json> --at <mm:ss.s> --said "<his exact words>" [--clip <local path to the clip>]

interim.about: Monday 26's accepted cuts serve beside his named frames until his scores exist. Their moments are read live from config/reference-cuts.json (reference_moments), never copied here.
